description: This is a PHP source file defining the class 'SaleShipping' which extends the OpenCart Controller. The class contains methods for handling the sale shipping report including viewing, listing, saving settings, and generating report data. It interacts with models, configurations, sessions, and views to generate the report interface and data.

classes.name: SaleShipping
classes.description: Controller class for handling sale shipping reports in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying the report interface, listing report data, saving report settings, and generating report content based on filters.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language assets, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the shipping report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST request, including permission checks and setting configuration values.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the report page view with report data, order statuses, and other related information.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered report data, including date range, grouping, order status, and pagination. Returns HTML view of report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a list of report data, likely in JSON or raw format.
